title: Clubs and activities

sports_answer.prompt: For this demo, sports registration is handled through the school athletics office. A completed registration form and current sports physical are required. [DEMO ANSWER]

other_activity.prompt: For this demo, the school activities coordinator can provide a list of clubs, meeting times, and registration instructions. [DEMO ANSWER]
